The Moon wants a heart-to-heart this morning.

The Moon is in Cancer all day and makes a friendly trine to Mercury in Scorpio this morning. Swipe for Taurus, Virgo and Capricorn, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Earth friend. 🌙

#earthsigns #taurus #virgo #capricorn #moonjournal
